## Experiential direction before an ownership judgment

The [affective realization study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) adds a specific candidate: an experience-directed aversive component could belong to the episode it targets, before a narrative owner represents it as mine. A substantive rival explains experience-directed action through further coping with a bodily directive. The comparison asks both **what the direction targets** and **how it participates in the experience**. Neither observed avoidance nor an episode identifier settles these questions.

Our proposed explanatory order begins with differentiated activity and investigates how experiential organization, means of changing it and ownership representations form within that activity. An episode's reflexive reference need not be a reference to a narrative person. This makes the proposed route more specific; it does not prove that the proposed organization exists or generates consciousness. A theory must identify its constituent relationships independently enough for the comparison to be tested. A retained disposition may fail to manifest, and a bodily directive may coexist with an experience-directed component; both possibilities constrain the test.

The current Lean model already connects acquired action-effect records to actual commands. It does not identify those commands as experiential constituents. Its patient episode number preserves the target of modeled service, but does not explain experiential unity. The study therefore adds an interpretation and realization obligation at these exact interfaces, without adding a desired implication as an axiom. Actual felt adversity, local welfare significance and practical force for another actor remain to be explained and justified. A command's existence or uptake does not supply that justification.

**体验可以先于叙事性的“这是我的”而具有趋避方向；但这一构成关系仍须说明和检验。须解释方向指向何物、如何参与体验本身，以及真实改变何以具有意义。命令被生成、被接受或被执行，都不能单独证成善恶。当前推进明确了这一候选关系，并未把它作为新公理加入 Lean。**

## 3. Ethical significance need not wait for an ownership judgment

# Current theory and research

**Affective realization before narrative ownership, 6 October 2026:** [argument, rival and integration](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) specify an experience-directed constitutive candidate and a separate-coping alternative, with discriminating conditions that retain unmanifest dispositions and coexisting bodily targets. Three primary theoretical comparisons are bounded by their actual reading scopes; two originals are preserved. The [generated-self chapter](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-SELF-AND-ETHICS.md#experiential-direction-before-an-ownership-judgment) and existing Lean interface documentation now connect this candidate to acquired command use and addressed service. No experiential realization, new theorem or ethical necessity is claimed. Next identify the formed episode, constituent relationship and intentional target without using an assumed self or valence label to settle them; C1/C2 remain open.

# Generative Existence (生生不息论)

**Affective direction and the formed I, 6 October 2026:** [the integrated chapter](unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-SELF-AND-ETHICS.md#experiential-direction-before-an-ownership-judgment) investigates an experiential target and its constitutive direction before narrative ownership. [Primary comparison and adversarial review](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) distinguish that candidate from further bodily coping and identify what the existing Lean model would still need to explain. This advances the realization question without adding laws or treating an operative command as ethical authority; the complete foundation remains open.

# Root-foundation review package

**Affective realization, 6 October 2026:** [candidate](AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-ARGUMENT.md), [rival and review](AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-REVIEW.md), [integration](AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) and [checks](AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-CHECKS.json) sharpen the formed-organization → experiential-affect connection before narrative ownership. The comparison preserves disposition/action and possible coexistence of bodily and reflexive content. It supplies a constitutive candidate and explicit revision tests, not a new controller, phenomenal realization, C1/C2 proof or completion. The existing Lean acquisition and service interfaces retain their established scopes.

# SOURCES manifest

**Affective realization primary comparison, 6 October 2026:** [originals and provenance](37-ethical-minimum-primary-2026-10-06/affective-realization/README.md) preserve Barlassina–Hayward’s published PDF and Martínez’s publisher HTML. The separately inspected corrigendum and Prueitt–Sezer–Sacchet’s allostatic paper remain link-only with access limits recorded. [The research integration](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) distinguishes source proposals from our tests and from empirical confirmation. No underlying clinical study is treated as independently reviewed.

## Affective realization interface

The [new source comparison and review](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) asks whether a directed component belongs to an experiential episode and what it targets. `ExactEffects` and `corrected_command_is_actually_used` establish prediction and execution under the existing law; neither identifies experiential content or constitutive participation. A future realization must explain those relationships and their formation without treating a command label as felt valence. This documentation adds no Lean declaration, law or axiom and does not change the recorded verification scope.

**Experiential interpretation, 6 October 2026.** The [affective realization study](../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/AFFECTIVE-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) distinguishes an episode's intentional target, constitutive organization and further coping responses. `PatientState.episode` addresses an operation; it does not identify experiential unity. `burden` remains a numerical field whose phenomenal interpretation is supplied, and `Realized`, C1 and C2 retain their existing contract meanings. Adding a reflexive label would not establish any of those interpretations. The study specifies a candidate and substantive rival for the omitted relationship; it adds no Lean premise or proof.
